question: Did the snowfall on Saturday 21 Dec 2024 reduce NYC yellow taxi trips compared with the other Saturdays in December 2024, and why?

calls.content:
{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  to_date(obs_date) AS date,
  snow_mm
FROM 
  whybot.nyc_weather_daily
WHERE 
  dayofweek(to_date(obs_date)) = 7
  AND obs_date >= DATE '2024-12-01'
  AND obs_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY 
  date",
  "tables_used": [
    "whybot.nyc_weather_daily"
  ],
  "note": "Fetches snowfall for each Saturday in December 2024. dayofweek returns 7 for Saturday. Date range filters to December 2024. Ordered chronologically."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT s.saturday_date,
       MAX(CASE WHEN s.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.holiday_name END) AS target_holiday_name,
       MAX(CASE WHEN s.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.is_national END) AS target_is_national,
       COUNT(DISTINCT h.holiday_date) AS holidays_on_target_saturday
FROM (
  SELECT to_date(CAST(concat('2024120', seq) AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS saturday_date
  FROM (
    SELECT seq FROM (
      SELECT sequence(1,4) AS seq
    )
  )
  LATERAL VIEW explode(seq) exploded AS seq
  WHERE mod(seq, 7) = 6
) s
LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = s.saturday_date
GROUP BY s.saturday_date
ORDER BY s.saturday_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.us_holidays"],
  "note": "Generates the 4 Saturdays in December 2024, left-joins US holidays, uses conditional aggregation to flag the target date 2024-12-21 versus baseline Saturdays."
}

{"sql":"WITH seq_gen AS (SELECT sequence(1,4) AS seq) SELECT s.saturday_date, MAX(CASE WHEN s.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.holiday_name END) AS target_holiday_name, MAX(CASE WHEN s.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.is_national END) AS target_is_national, COUNT(DISTINCT h.holiday_date) AS holidays_on_target_saturday FROM (SELECT to_date(CAST(concat('2024120', seq) AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS saturday_date FROM seq_gen LATERAL VIEW explode(seq) exploded AS seq_alias WHERE mod(seq_alias, 7) = 6) s LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = s.saturday_date GROUP BY s.saturday_date ORDER BY s.saturday_date","tables_used":["whybot.us_holidays","seq_gen"],"note":"Uses exploded alias seq_alias to avoid ambiguous reference error; checks holidays on each Saturday in December 2024 including the target date 2024-12-21."}

{"sql":"WITH seq_gen AS (SELECT sequence(1,4) AS seq) SELECT s.saturday_date, MAX(CASE WHEN s.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.holiday_name END) AS target_holiday_name, MAX(CASE WHEN s.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.is_national END) AS target_is_national, COUNT(DISTINCT h.holiday_date) AS holidays_on_target_saturday FROM (SELECT to_date(CAST(concat('2024120', seq) AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS saturday_date FROM seq_gen LATERAL VIEW explode(seq) exploded AS seq_alias WHERE mod(seq_alias, 7) = 6) s LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = s.saturday_date GROUP BY s.saturday_date ORDER BY s.saturday_date","tables_used":["whybot.us_holidays","seq_gen"],"note":"Uses seq_alias to avoid ambiguous reference error; generates 4 Saturdays in Dec 2024 and checks holidays on each."}

{"sql":"WITH dates AS (SELECT to_date(concat('2024120', seq), 'yyyyMMdd') AS saturday_date FROM (SELECT sequence(1,4) AS seq) t LATERAL VIEW explode(seq) exploded AS seq_alias WHERE mod(seq_alias, 7) = 6) SELECT d.saturday_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.holiday_name END) AS target_holiday_name, MAX(CASE WHEN d.saturday_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN h.is_national END) AS target_is_national, COUNT(DISTINCT h.holiday_date) AS holidays_on_target_saturday FROM dates d LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = d.saturday_date GROUP BY d.saturday_date ORDER BY d.saturday_date","tables_used":["whybot.us_holidays"],"note":"Uses seq_alias to resolve ambiguous reference; generates exactly 4 Saturdays in Dec 2024 and checks US holidays on each."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_day_name, d_weekend, d_holiday, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
JOIN whybot.date_dim ON whybot.yellow_daily.d_date_sk = whybot.date_dim.d_date_sk
WHERE d_year = 2024
  AND d_moy = 12
  AND d_dow = 7
GROUP BY d_date_sk, d_date, d_day_name, d_weekend, d_holiday
ORDER BY d_date_sk",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "whybot.date_dim"],
  "note": "Filters to Saturdays (d_dow=7) in December 2024, groups by date to show trip counts for comparison."
}

{"sql":"SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_day_name, d_weekend, d_holiday, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
JOIN tpcds_db.date_dim ON whybot.yellow_daily.d_date_sk = tpcds_db.date_dim.d_date_sk
WHERE d_year = 2024
  AND d_moy = 12
  AND d_dow = 7
GROUP BY d_date_sk, d_date, d_day_name, d_weekend, d_holiday
ORDER BY d_date_sk","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","tpcds_db.date_dim"],"note":"Confirm all comparison dates are Saturdays using calendar dimension"}

{"sql":"SELECT d.date_sk, d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend, d.d_holiday, y.trips
FROM tpcds_db.date_dim d
JOIN whybot.yellow_daily y ON y.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2024
  AND d.d_moy = 12
  AND d.d_dow = 7
ORDER BY d.d_date_sk
LIMIT 200","tables_used":["tpcds_db.date_dim","whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Limited to 200 rows per requirement; d_dow=7 filters Saturdays only. No GROUP BY needed as each date_sk is unique."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  d AS trip_date,
  COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM 
  whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE 
  d BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY 
  d
ORDER BY 
  d",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Checks daily trip counts for all December 2024 Saturdays. Aggregates to one row per date to avoid self-joins on the same view."
}

{"sql":"SELECT to_date(d) AS trip_date, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE to_date(d) BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' GROUP BY to_date(d) ORDER BY to_date(d) LIMIT 50","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Aggregates daily trip counts for December 2024 Saturdays only; uses to_date() to resolve the grain column d into a comparable date literal."}

{"sql":"SELECT trip_date, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' GROUP BY trip_date ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 50","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Checks daily trip counts for December 2024 Saturdays; yellow_daily likely lacks daily grain, so this will return few or no rows for Saturday dates."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  trip_date,
  trips,
  avg_total_amount,
  avg_trip_distance,
  CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_target_date
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Verifies trip count is non-zero and shows the target date flag for 2024-12-21 against other December Saturdays."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  h.holiday_date,
  h.holiday_name,
  h.is_national
FROM whybot.us_holidays h
WHERE h.holiday_date IN (DATE '2024-12-20', DATE '2024-12-23')
ORDER BY h.holiday_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.us_holidays"],
  "note": "Check for US federal or state holidays on Friday Dec 20 and Monday Dec 23 2024 that could affect travel patterns around Saturday Dec 21."
}
